title: Yuu Rain Dash
description: Rain-triggered mobility dash with double-sneak trigger.
body:
# Yuu Rain Dash

Rain-triggered mobility dash with double-sneak trigger.

## Features
- Dash ability only when rain is active.
- Double-sneak quick trigger for combat and traversal mobility.
- Manual command cast available with cooldown handling.
- Water-themed particle/sound feedback on successful dash.

## Command
- `/raindash [dash|status|on|off|reload]`

## Permission
- `yuuraindash.use`

## Compatibility
- Loaders: spigot, paper, purpur
- Game versions: 1.16.5, 1.17.1, 1.18.2, 1.19.4, 1.20.1, 1.20.4, 1.20.6, 1.21.1

## Notes
- Lightweight implementation with configurable behavior in `config.yml`.
- Built by **yuutaxd**.
